pages.subject: Could you tell me where it is?
paragraphs: Visitor programme: tour, 10 am, reception. Talk, 11:30 am, room 2. Cloakroom, ground floor beside information point. Ask the desk whether a standard tour is included in the entrance fee; do not infer that every activity is included.

pages.title: At the information desk
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Could you tell me where the guided tour starts?
lines.audioText: Could you tell me where the guided tour starts?
lines.translation: Pode me dizer onde começa a visita guiada?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: At the reception desk at ten. The talk is later, at eleven thirty
lines.audioText: At the reception desk at ten. The talk is later, at eleven thirty.
lines.translation: Na recepção às dez. A palestra é depois, às onze e meia

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Do you know if the tour is included in the entrance fee?
lines.audioText: Do you know if the tour is included in the entrance fee?
lines.translation: Você sabe se a visita está incluída no ingresso?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The standard tour is included. The special workshop costs extra
lines.audioText: The standard tour is included. The special workshop costs extra.
lines.translation: A visita normal está incluída. A oficina especial custa à parte

questions.prompt: Where and when does the guided tour start?
questions.answer: The guided tour starts at reception at ten

questions.prompt: Is the standard tour included in the entrance fee?
questions.answer: Yes, the standard tour is included in the entrance fee

pages.title: A useful follow-up
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thanks. Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
lines.audioText: Thanks. Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
lines.translation: Obrigada. Pode me dizer onde posso deixar minha bolsa?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: There’s a cloakroom on the ground floor, beside the information point
lines.audioText: There’s a cloakroom on the ground floor, beside the information point.
lines.translation: Tem um guarda-volumes no térreo, ao lado do ponto de informações

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: And is the talk still in room two?
lines.audioText: And is the talk still in room two?
lines.translation: E a palestra continua na sala dois?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That’s what the timetable says. Please check the board before you go
lines.audioText: That’s what the timetable says. Please check the board before you go.
lines.translation: É o que diz a programação. Confira o quadro antes de ir

pages.title: Ask for useful information
pages.instruction: Answer in your own way and ask your teacher a follow-up question

items.prompt: What would you like to find out?
items.cue: Ask for one piece of information politely
items.hint: Could you tell me where … is?

items.prompt: Do you need to check anything else?
items.cue: Ask a follow-up question about time, access or what is included

items.prompt: How would you check that you understood the answer?
items.cue: Restate the useful detail and confirm it politely
items.hint: So, … Have I understood that correctly?

pages.title: Keep statement order inside a polite question
pages.instruction: Connect the meaning, the form and the example

rows.subject: Polite question with statement order
rows.verb: Could you tell me where + subject + is?
rows.example: Could you tell me where the cloakroom is?

rows.subject: Check a yes/no detail
rows.verb: Do you know if + statement order?
rows.example: Do you know if the tour is included?

pages.title: Plan your visit
pages.instruction: Ask the information desk what you need to plan your visit

pages.title: The talk has moved
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. There’s a room change for the eleven thirty talk. It’s now in room four, not room two. The ten o’clock tour still starts at reception. The message doesn’t say whether room four has step-free access, and one person in our group needs it. Could you check that before we leave the ground floor? The entrance fee still includes the standard tour; we haven’t booked the extra workshop
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. There’s a room change for the eleven thirty talk. It’s now in room four, not room two. The ten o’clock tour still starts at reception. The message doesn’t say whether room four has step-free access, and one person in our group needs it. Could you check that before we leave the ground floor? The entrance fee still includes the standard tour; we haven’t booked the extra workshop.
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!
